chunk_map.heading: You knew the craft; building rationed it
The post-it was the craft on a budget
An opportunity tree on Friday, a feature roadmap on Monday
A feature factory ships without asking if it worked
An outcome is what your customers do differently
Your customers hire the product to make progress

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: expanded L31 "Those are signs from John Cutler's list" in chunk 3 — "Those" resolves to the signs listed in the preceding paragraph and the list is named in the same sentence; "His" at L33/L44 binds to Cutler / Seiden named in the same chunk. Harm (slide cannot be followed) absent.
grep of body for positional/cross-file callbacks ("opening lecture", "earlier", "last") finds none; closest L20 "The tree stays on the wall" refers within chunk.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no "the X you did/saw" backward reference in any chunk

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no guess/predict instruction or live-demo beat

rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: chunk 4 (expanded L40-44) is three paragraphs each carrying a claim; every chunk has a self-carrying claim, smallest is chunk 1 (3 paragraphs). No wait-state slide.
Closest: chunk 3 header "A feature factory ships without asking if it worked" vs L33 caveat that the term names missing validation, not volume; caveat refines, does not contradict, the header.

Closest: L29 "Nobody measures the impact. Nobody compares…" is a pair, not a triple; L44 "Not \"adds a dashboard\", but what a named customer will be doing…" is one negation + one positive, not the banned Not X. Not Y. Z.; L11 "was not naive. It was…" same single contrast. No superlatives, no number+retraction (L53 40% stated flat), no empty verb triplet.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep for surface/firing/compendium/forcing function/beat/mood/Connections in slide bodies → 0 hits; "trio" appears only in maintainer block (L64).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No bold in any chunk (grep \*\* in body → 0); budget of ≤1 respected.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: lecture file whose slides are included slide files; phase wrapper supplied by the enclosing module include, no phase-less prose section

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no Phase N / Step N headers or references

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file curriculum/lectures/apt101-building-rationed-it.md → slides: 5, oversized: 0 (limits 210 words / 6 bullets)

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: All five lecture headings are claims, e.g. L4 "The post-it was the craft on a budget", L37 "An outcome is what your customers do differently"; none is a bare label.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: L11 "The post-it was not naive. It was what the craft shrank to when building was expensive." could read as header-restating kicker (class c), but it carries the slide's new content (naive vs cost cause) that the header does not state; L22 last sentence likewise adds the tree-as-picture claim. No doctrine restatement or design commentary.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no evidence of a retitle: no provenance note and no header-without-body commit signal in the maintainer block

notes: Chunk line ranges are against the expanded view (slide files inlined); raw source is include lines only (L3-11). Maintainer block has no accept-notes beyond Quality/STATUS lines. Slide-file wording and backing belong to slides/*.md.
